amd_reference.ti_document: ZHCAG60, dated Dec2025; TI TPS6X99X example, not ASUS IT8853 firmware
amd_reference.ti_summary: PD-controlled AMD crossbar handshake and separate retimer programming through a safe state precede the target mode; command/result/status traffic is distinct from ordinary Windows UCSI completion.
amd_reference.infineon_summary: AMD platform firmware supplies I2C-master support for APU and retimers; configuration includes PS8830 selection, per-port retimer address, AMD port index and role preferences.
amd_reference.asus_applicability: Architecture lead only. Exact ITE firmware implementation, ASUS control bus, addresses, events, ordering and safe observer remain unverified. No TI register/opcode is an ASUS command.

reviewed_windows_scope.limit: Reviewed request dispatch and existing update caller chain; the bridge can carry I/O but no ASUS attachment-time mode writer has been identified. Not a claim that all Windows code is passive.

next_question: Find the actual ASUS PD-to-APU and retimer mode-programming messages/caller, then relate them to fresh router-detection state. Do not equate wake status, cable version, a configured-mode flag or successful UCSI completion with a usable link.
